author: The Spiffing Brit
description:
Welcome one and all to a lovely stream about Flamecraft a digital boardgame from the team behind wingspan and wyrmspan (two of my favourite games of all time). After a trip to gamescom and meeting the wonderful team of Monster Couch myself and RT Game have decided it would be a wonderful idea to do a stream together so we roped in the wonderful hazzor to join us for the madness and destruction of our friendships as we argue over the details of this game like an old family destroyed by a particularly viscous game of monopoly. 

If you want to checkout the game you can do so here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3201730?utm_campaign=flamecraft_launch&utm_content=spiff
